Investigated host and infra side. Summary: 
- AZ breakdown: us-west-2a showing 12% 5xx, us-west-2b 1.2%, us-west-2c 0.9%
- Network egress from 2a to backend cache shows elevated latencies and packet retransmits starting ~08:48
- Node pool in 2a has two recent OOM restarts on inference workers; kernel logs attached in the zip I'll send to the thread.

Immediate mitigation options (ranked):
1) Divert new traffic away from us-west-2a at the routing layer to 2b/2c and, failing that, to a neighboring region (westus -> eastus) per the cross-region diversion runbook.
2) Scale up capacity (spin additional instances) in 2a and isolate nodes with OOMs; but that may take 6–8 minutes to stabilize and could worsen queue times while new nodes warm up.
3) Apply temporary rate-limiting thresholds for FinServe routes (non-optimal but buys time).

Requesting exec sign-off to perform routing diversion. I'll prepare the playbook artifacts and the log bundle.

— Ben
